purpose: Integrate operator-supplied Kaggle WTA 2016-2017 historical Match Winner odds into private BlinQ canonical history and research market sidecars.
dedup_policy: Each match must have exactly two mutually mirrored rows with swapped names/ages/ratings/odds, identical result and complementary winner flag. Any inconsistency fails closed.
identity_policy: Exact source date + exact normalized unordered WTA player pair + exact canonical winner + unique canonical candidate; rank differences over 25 are rejected when both sides have uncapped rank evidence.
market_policy: Existing canonical historical odds marker is never replaced. Source odds are persisted as player1/player2, bookmaker identity unknown, timestamp unknown, benchmark-only.
result_policy: Source result and winner flag are identity-validation evidence only and are never introduced as same-match model features.
